newsitem.title: UK: British Gas seeks MMC inquiry - paper.
newsitem.headline: British Gas seeks MMC inquiry - paper.

text.p: British Gas is expected this week to seek a reference to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) to settle with regulator Ofgas over price controls for its TransCo pipeline business, the Independent on Sunday said.

The British Gas board meets this week. And barring last minute concessions from Ofgas, the paper said British Gas is expected to refuse to accept the price curbs demanded by the regulator. Such a refusal would refer the matter to the MMC.
Ofgas set a 7 October deadline for the company to respond to modified proposals, published last month.
Since then, British Gas and its regulator have been in negotiations to hammer out a compromise.
The Independent, quoting unnamed sources close to the talks, said there has been no break in the deadlock.

Ofgas' original proposals, published in May, suggested controls that would reduce the company's revenues by 650 million to 850 million stg annually. After three months of negotiations, Ofgas revised its proposals late last month.
